title: psilotrichum humile
intro: Psilotrichum humile, commonly known as Yerba de la Miel, is a plant species that belongs to the Psilotrichaceae family. It is a shrub-like plant native to South America, traditionally used in folk medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Psilotrichum humile include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate respiratory issues, making it a valuable remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
